source: Codex re-probe c5 (thread/resume with an unknown thread id), 0.159.2, 2026-09-30; model/list reply spliced from re-probe cat (3 of 8 rows, descriptions neutralized); VIA's resume adds approvalsReviewer and excludeTurns, which the probe's bogus resume omitted; the run ends at VIA's stdin close (await_eof) right after the refusal, as the probe closed stdin at the end of the run (exit 0 recorded)

unasserted.why: a definite rejection on the server route: C2 §2's cleanup table has no row for a rejected submission that started no vendor turn, so quiescent versus uncertain is undecided; reported to the coordinator

expect.notes: thread/resume of a thread with no stored rollout is refused with -32600 `no rollout found for thread id ...` before any turn/start: a definite rejection, Err(Rejected(SessionGone)), no resend and no replacement thread/start (C2 §2 Submission boundary, Reopen; vendors/codex.md §3). The kind comes from the message text, since the code is the generic -32600. The replay pins the stdin sequence: thread/resume without developerInstructions, then nothing but EOF after the refusal (await_eof), so no thread/start or turn/start follows.
